(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)

  intro n hn

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i)  := by
  have swap a b (hr : relation a b) i :
      7 ∣ b i * 10 ^ i.val - a i * 10 ^ i.val + digits_to_num a := by
    refine dvd_trans (((hrelation a b).mp hr).2 i) (dvd_of_eq ?_)
    apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  intro d e f h i
  have hd := swap d e h.1
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hd j)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    ← congrFun hdigits_to_num, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num, Fin.sum_const] at hs
  apply ((show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩).pow_right (n := i.val)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  refine dvd_trans
    (dvd_sub (dvd_sub hs (dvd_add (hd i) (swap e f h.2 i))) (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d))) (dvd_of_eq ?_)
  ring1

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  suffices (mulLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ c)).compr₂ₛₗ
        (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF) =
      mulLinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι c) ∘ₗ ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF) by
    exact congr($this a b)
  apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
  intro φs' φs
  simp only [LinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply,
    LinearMap.mulRight_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, mulLinearMap_apply,
    ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  obtain ⟨a1, a2, ht⟩ : ∃ a1 a2, ∀ l,
      (∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) →
      ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs)) = a1 * ofCrAnListF l * a2 :=
    ⟨_ * _, _ * _, fun l hl => by
      simpa only [crAnTimeOrderList, ofCrAnListF_append, mul_assoc] using
        congrArg ofCrAnListF (insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ φs' l φs hl)⟩
  have h0 := ht [] (by simp)
  simp at h0
  trans crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
    (ι a1 * ι c * ι a2)
  · apply congrArg ι
    simp only [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
      map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.singleton_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    rw [ht [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ]), ht [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_sub, smul_comm]
  · rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
      (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ), mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← h0]
    by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
        hq.symm,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      exact (Algebra.mul_smul_comm _ _ _).symm
    · simp only [c, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
